name: Halo Heart
slug: A place to picture for doorway training, not a door to open yet.
description: A place Sylan treats as a good picture for Gerk to hold while training the doorway.

log.summary: During doorway training, Sylan names Halo Heart as a good place for Gerk to picture, and tells him not to open a door to it now, in contrast to going home before the mission is finished.
